name: The Mirror of Galadriel Rules
text: “Gandalf as Ring-Lord would have been far worse than Sauron.” — Tolkien, Letter 246 Welcome to The Mirror of Galadriel (Set 2), an unofficial fan scenario, developed by A Long-extended Party (ALeP). This expansion is meant to be combined with the original The Mirror of Galadriel scenario released in 2025, now referred to as The Mirror of Galadriel (Set 1). Set 2 includes a Shire scenario, villain Gandalf, new options for enemy waves and boons, and a dedicated objective for easy mode. Please consult the rules for Set 1 to use these cards. Component Overview The Mirror of Galadriel (Set 2) includes 53 cards:  • 1 Rules Card• 15 Boon Cards  • 36 Encounter Cards• 1 Easy Mode Objective Card Web Resources You can check for any updates from A Long-extended Party at www.alongextendedparty.com. New Boons When setting up any The Mirror of Galadriel scenario, you may include the boons from any of the sets you own.

name: The Mirror of Galadriel 1
text: Villain Gandalf The Villain side of Gandalf makes each player turn the top card of their decks faceup and play or discard it in some cases, representing his desire to do good that has been twisted by The One Ring. The cases are: Whenever the top card of your deck could be played as if it were in your hand, it must immediately be played, ignoring resource match. Allies and attachments may be played during any action window this way, but all other play requirements must still be met. Each ally played this way gains turncoat. If the top card of your deck is unique and a copy is already in play, discard it. This is a constant effect with no limit. Whenever the top card of your deck is played or discarded, immediately turn the next card faceup and apply the effect again. Example: Joe has Ethir Swordsman on top of his deck, and after gaining resources has 1 resource on each of his heroes (a [lore], [tactics], and [spirit] hero). During the resource phase action window, he must spend any 2 resources and play Ethir Swordsman, which gains turncoat. He then turns up Quickbeam, but a copy is already in play, so he discards it and turns up Hasty Stroke. This card remains on top of his deck because, even though he has 1 resource, it cannot be played. Later, in the combat phase, an enemy attacks Joe and reveals a shadow card that gives it +1 [attack]. Joe must play Hasty Stroke from the top of his deck to cancel it.

name: Tookish Defenders
text: Tookish Defenders gets +2 [attack] and +2 [defense] while you are engaged with an enemy with an engagement cost higher than your threat. Response: After you exhaust Tookish Defenders, remove 1 progress from your active location.

name: Fireworks
text: Attach to a hero. Action: Add Fireworks to the victory display to choose a player. Discard all shadow cards dealt to all enemies engaged with that player.

name: Supplies from Bree
text: Attach to your play area. Response: When Supplies from Bree enters play, place 5 resource tokens on it. Action: Remove 1 resource token from Supplies from Bree to heal 1 damage from a character. If there are no resource tokens on Supplies from Bree, add it to the victory display.

name: Paladin Took II
text: Each enemy in play gets +5 engagement cost. Response: When you engage a non-unique enemy with an engagement cost higher than your threat, exhaust Paladin Took II. Then, that enemy cannot attack you this round.

name: Organized Defense
text: Attach to a hero. Limit 1 per player. Response: Add Organized Defense to the victory display to cancel X progress just placed on the main quest. X is the number of boons you have earned.

name: Easy Mode
text: Setup: To play easy mode, attach this card to Siege of Middle-earth. You are playing easy mode. Ignore the Forced effect on Siege of Middle-earth during even-numbered rounds.

name: The Ring Stays in the Shire
text: Setup: Choose a starting hero (a Hobbit hero, if able) and attach The One Ring to it, Tempting side faceup. Use The Mirror of Galadriel - Shire encounter set to build the encounter deck. Flip this card over and add it to the staging area.

name: The Ring Stays in the Shire
text: Forced: After your active location is explored, place 2 [threat] tokens here and retreat 2. The Ring-lord player may exhaust The One Ring to cancel the retreat 2.

name: Barrow Wights
text: Setup: Search your collection for 2x Barrow-wight, 3x Dark-wight, and 3x Cold-wight (from Fog on the Barrow-downs). Shuffle them together to create the Wave 1 deck. Set this card aside, then flip it over.

name: Ancient Wight
text: X is 6 plus 2[pp]. Forced: After a Wight enemy attacks and does not destroy a character, either the defending player retreats 2 or that enemy cannot take damage until the end of the round.

name: Bree Lowlifes
text: Setup: Search your collection for 3x Lawless Ruffian, 2x Greenway Footpad, and 3x Chetwood Outlaw (from Murder at the Prancing Pony). Shuffle them together to create the Wave 2 deck. Set aside the 5 Suspect enemies from the same set. Set this card aside, then flip it over.

name: The Boss
text: When Revealed: Add 1 random set-aside Suspect to the staging area. It loses “Cannot have attachments” while The Boss is in play. Attach The Boss to it. Counts as a Title attachment with the text: “Attached enemy gains the Wave 2 and Commander traits, and gets +3[pp] hit points. Forced: After a player raises their threat from a card effect, they retreat 2. Forced: When attached enemy is destroyed, remove The Boss from the game.”

name: Take It Gandalf!
text: Setup: Resolve after the Setup effect of the Scenario objective. Unattach The One Ring and attach it, Tempting side faceup, to Gandalf from The Mirror of Galadriel - Gandalf encounter set, objective-hero side faceup, and put him into play. Shuffle the remaining cards of that encounter set together to create the Villain deck. Flip this card over and add it to the staging area.

name: Take It Gandalf!
text: Forced: When stage 4A instructs you to reveal the set-aside Villain card, instead flip The One Ring over, remove all tokens from Gandalf, flip him over, and add him to the staging area. Each player chooses 1 character for every 5 characters they control (rounded up). Those characters gain turncoat.

name: Oatbarton Gate
text: Travel: Return an enemy engaged with you to the staging area. Until the end of the round, that enemy does not make engagement checks, but will attack you from the staging area during the combat phase as if it was engaged with you.
shadow: Shadow: Place 1 [threat] token on The Ring Stays in the Shire (place 3 tokens instead if you do not have an active location).

name: The Hill
text: If the round number is 5 or 6, the next player with an opportunity to travel must travel here, if able. Travel: Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck and discard the top X cards. X is the number of [threat] tokens on The Ring Stays in the Shire. Each player chooses a different treachery discarded in this way and reveals it.

name: Green Hill Country
text: Travel: Retreat 5. You may exhaust any number of characters to reduce this retreat value by their combined [defense].
shadow: Shadow: Either the Ring-lord player exhausts The One Ring, or the attacking enemy gets +3 [attack].

name: The High Hay
text: Travel: Deal 1 shadow card to an enemy engaged with you.
shadow: Shadow: Retreat 2 (retreat 4 instead if you do not have an active location).

name: North Farthing
text: Forced: After North Farthing becomes your active location, either exhaust a Ranger character you control, or search the encounter deck and discard pile for a copy of Wraiths from the North and reveal it. Shuffle the encounter deck if searched.
shadow: Shadow: Either deal 1 damage to the defending character or retreat 2 (if you do not have an active location, do both instead).

name: East Farthing
text: Travel: Discard 2 random cards from your hand. You may search your deck or collection for an ally named Farmer Maggot or a Creature ally with a printed cost of 2 or less and put it into play under your control. Shuffle your deck if searched.
shadow: Shadow: Either deal 1 damage to the defending character or retreat 2 (if you do not have an active location, do both instead).

name: South Farthing
text: Travel: Exhaust all ready attachments you control. If you exhausted at least 3 attachments, you may search your deck for an Item attachment and add it to your hand. If it has the Pipe trait, put it into play instead. Shuffle your deck if searched.
shadow: Shadow: Either deal 1 damage to the defending character or retreat 2 (if you do not have an active location, do both instead).

name: West Farthing
text: Travel: Raise your threat by 5. You may search your deck, collection, or unearned The Mirror of Galadriel boons for a unique Hobbit ally and put it into play under your control (you do not earn the boon). Shuffle your deck if searched.
shadow: Shadow: Either deal 1 damage to the defending character or retreat 2 (if you do not have an active location, do both instead).

name: Distrust of the Big Folk
text: When Revealed: Exhaust the ready character with the highest [defense]. If there are 3 or more players, repeat the previous effect. Until the end of the combat phase, characters exhausted in this way cannot ready.
shadow: Shadow: The defending character is no longer defending this attack. You may exhaust a different character to declare it as the defender.

name: Shoddy Defenses
text: When Revealed: The player that controls the most attachments chooses: for each attachment they control, either discard it or retreat 1. If they controlled 3 or fewer attachments before resolving this effect, Shoddy Defenses gains surge.
shadow: Shadow: For each attachment on the defending character, either discard it or retreat 2.

name: Wraiths from the North
text: When Revealed: Each player with a Northwest, North, or Northeast active location places the top 2 cards of their deck facedown in their play area. They count as Undead enemies with 1 [threat], 1 [attack], 1 [defense], and 1 hit point. If no cards are placed this way, Wraiths from the North gains surge.

name: Wolves from the East
text: When Revealed: Each player with a Northeast, East, or Southeast active location must resolve the following effect 3 times: Either deal a shadow card to an enemy with no shadow cards, or deal 1 damage to a hero you control.

name: Dunlendings from the South
text: When Revealed: Each player with a Southwest, South, or Southeast active location draws 1 card, then raises their threat by the number of cards in their hand. If no player raised their threat by 3 or more this way, Dunlendings from the South gains surge.

name: Corsairs from the West
text: When Revealed: Each player with a Northwest, West, or Southwest active location moves 1 resource token from each hero they control to an enemy in play. Until the end of the round, enemies get +1 [attack] for each resource token on them. If no resources were moved this way, Corsairs from the West gains surge.

name: Gandalf
text: The first player gains control of Gandalf. He is considered to have the printed [leadership], [lore], [spirit], and [tactics] icons. Action: Exhaust The One Ring to (choose 1): Reduce your threat by 1, deal 1 damage to an enemy in play, or draw 1 card.

name: Gandalf
text: X is 8 plus 4[pp]. Each player plays with the top card of their deck faceup. They must play or discard this card in some cases (see rules). Allies played this way gain turncoat. While there are any printed allies with turncoat in play, Gandalf gains indestructible. When Gandalf is destroyed, the players win the game.

name: Flame of Anor
text: Cannot be canceled. When Revealed: The player that revealed this card discards the top card of their deck. Gandalf makes an immediate attack against that player and gets +X [attack] for this attack. X is the printed cost of the discarded card.

name: Narya, Under the One
text: Cannot be canceled. When Revealed: The player that revealed this card chooses 2 enemies engaged with them. Those enemies get +3 [attack] until the end of the phase and they each make an immediate attack. If no attacks were made in this way, that player chooses 2 characters they control. They gain turncoat.

name: Sneak Attack
text: Cannot be canceled. When Revealed: The player that revealed this card must deal 4 damage to a hero they control, discard 3 random cards from their hand, and raise their threat by 5.

name: Word of Command
text: Cannot be canceled. When Revealed: If you are playing alongside other groups, ask a player from another group to search the encounter deck for any card and reveal it. Otherwise, the player that revealed this card searches the encounter deck for the enemy with the highest [attack] and reveals it. Shuffle the encounter deck.
